remarks: PEACEFUL COUNTRY LIVING AT ITS' BEST! Welcome to this well-maintained and carefully thought out home.  The first thing you will notice as you drive into the blacktop driveway is the variety of plants and flowers scattered throughout the property. This is the home of a master gardener and it shows. A spacious backyard complimented by a gorgeous composite deck (built 2012)featuring vinyl railings and a Sunsetter retractable awning take outdoor entertaining to a new level. As you enter the home you will immediately notice the beauty of the natural woodwork throughout and unique built in cabinetry that creates the warmest feeling kitchen you have ever walked into. The formal dining room features additional built in cabinetry and a glass door that allows easy access to the deck. The downstairs continues to entice with a comfortable living room, an office area and a convenient combination laundry room/ half bath.(built 2018) Upstairs you will find more natural woodwork, three bedrooms and a full bath. Looking for more storage?  The staircase from the 2nd floor will take you to a full attic. In addition to all these great features you will find thermal windows throughout the entire home, as well as Leaf filter gutter guards on both the house and garage (with full transferable warranty). Be sure to add this home to your must see list so you don't miss the chance to live in a great home with convenient access to Batavia, Leroy and the New York State Thruway. Showings begin Sunday October 18th at noon. Delayed negotiations until Tuesday October 27th at 5 pm.
